findings.title: Reject sample frame semantic changes before using content evidence
findings.requirement: Fixed sample schema must correspond field by field to current frame ownership, role, zone/order and content; identity mismatch stops successors.
findings.trigger: Initial full inventory is normal. Single-sample frame response has identical rect_id/file_id/question order, but r-3-1 changes choice→answer and r-3-2 zone index changes 1→3.
findings.actual: collect completes all 11 business GET steps and returns READONLY_REVIEW; choice text is AVAILABLE and bound using stale initial inventory frames.
findings.cause: Sample response checks only an ID set and book/question identity. Its role/index/directory/page/bbox/parent/content fields are discarded. expected_frames remains the initial inventory projection.
findings.expected: Any unapproved semantic mismatch is a terminal sample read failure; do not execute info/content successors. If comparisons succeed, bind content to the actual validated sample rows in a proven order.
findings.limits: Synthetic transport/image/UI/file stubs; actual collect/decode/selection/current_code/register_sample/bound_content/check paths used. No platform behavior or real write is asserted.

findings.title: Lexical token co-occurrence does not establish current getter and response schema
findings.requirement: Sample API paths/parameters/zones must be derived from current code/response; unknown parameters must not be probed; schema evidence must be field-bound.
findings.actual_static: has_read searches field words anywhere in a broad block and endpoint names/zone strings anywhere in the asset. has_content only adds global presence of ocr_result and success. register_sample then registers five hardcoded GETs from those booleans.
findings.cause: No proof links the tokens to the selected getter arguments, its concrete other endpoint paths, or the data.success/data.ocr_result decoder response object.
findings.expected: Keep lexical hits as CURRENT_CODE observations with applicability UNKNOWN until concrete getter/parameter/zone/response bindings are demonstrated. Only register the evidenced paths/parameters; supply field-level source refs.
findings.limits: C15 executable counterexample NOT_RUN after R01 stop. This is a static logic finding; no fabricated runtime output.

findings.title: Full original-image decoding is absent
findings.requirement: Reject invalid/truncated original image bytes; dimensions/hash and source facts must describe a usable original, rather than a readable header.
findings.actual_static: original_info reads img.size/img.format and calls img.verify(), but never loads pixel data. There is no later byte decoder in original_once before those bytes are saved and described.
findings.expected: Perform a full decode/load from the exact bytes and fail closed on decode errors; retain a valid-header/truncated-JPEG negative control.
findings.limits: C14 truncated-image runtime test NOT_RUN after R01 stop. No claim is made that a particular corrupted file was accepted in this review.

findings.title: Worker release state can say RELEASED after creation-identity mismatch
findings.requirement: Exact held creation identity is part of release proof; mismatch must remain UNKNOWN.
findings.actual_static: The mismatch at 641-642 appends an error, but state at 670-672 checks job/handle closure and exit_observed without identity equality or absence of identity errors.
findings.expected: Release state explicitly requires creation identity match; otherwise UNKNOWN. Retain error and parent failure.
findings.limits: The parent still returns failure because errors is nonempty, so this is not a demonstrated live admission bypass. C16 runtime check NOT_RUN.
